title: NGINX UI plugin catalog
description: The static catalog document a host fetches from a marketplace source, schema_version 1, including the per-platform downloads of RFC 0001 (spec/02-packaging.md PKG-14 through PKG-17) and the publisher members of PKG-24. Packages carry their own signature (PKG-19, PKG-20, RFC 0012), so a release names none; signature_url and signed_by of older catalogs are ignored. The reference host reads it in internal/plugin/marketplace.go. Unknown members are ignored by a host, so the schema allows them.

schema_version.description: The only catalog layout spec 1.x defines. Adding downloads did not change it: a host that does not know downloads still reads download_url.

platformKey.description: NAME-9: <goos>-<goarch> as Go spells them, or any.

localized.description: Locale code to text, en is the fallback.

author_public_key.description: PKG-24: minisign public key (the base64 line of a .pub file) the author signs the packages of this entry with. A package downloaded from this entry and signed with it is community (SEC-18).

trust.description: PKG-24: informational label for listing and filtering. A host derives the level of a package from its signer (SEC-18) and never grants one from this member (SEC-19).

stage.description: Maturity shown next to the plugin, e.g. production or beta. PKG-28: beta marks the whole plugin as beta.

download.description: PKG-14: one package of a release.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the package file, a check of the download (PKG-16).

version.description: Semantic version, equal to the version of every package of the release.

platforms.description: Summary of where the release installs: every key of downloads plus the platforms the portable package serves. Empty or absent means the portable package runs everywhere.

downloads.description: PKG-14: per-platform packages, keyed by <goos>-<goarch> or any. A host picks downloads[platform], then downloads[any], then the portable package (PKG-15).

download_url.description: The portable package, the fallback for every platform downloads does not name. May be empty when downloads is present.

beta.description: PKG-28: the publisher calls this release beta. A version with a prerelease part is beta without it.

manifest.description: PKG-17: snapshot of the release manifest, whose server.executables names every platform the release ships.
